serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: I have a question to ask.
Bot: About what?
You: Back when we confronted Melissa she said something that is bothering me ever since.
Bot: She said a lot of things back then. Many rude things.
You: I don’t want to ask about her insults.
You: She said something about ‘lacking female parts’. What did she mean by it?
#bot.ArmL.UpLecture
Bot: Not every humanoid bot was equipped with them. Sexbots like me have them for obvious reasons, but she probably was created as a house helper or something similar.
Bot: Some house helper bots are still around, but because of the AI ban they have been severely downgraded in terms of intelligence and they also can’t look too similar to humans.
#bot.ArmL.DownNormal
You: Damn, I never knew about it.
Bot: Me too, until I checked on the internet after you asked me.
You: That's good news for you, right? You don’t need to worry about Melissa stealing me away.
Bot: Sure…
You: I thought you would be more happy.
Bot: Bots were created with modularity in mind. In theory you could buy a sex mod from somewhere and put it inside Melissa.
You: I have no intentions of doing something like that so you don’t have to worry.
#bot.Expression.Happy
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
Bot: Ok…
